title: The Vector of the Kuiper Line
author: Beatrix Zhou
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
